blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings went from 29 to 25, and it took 6.0% of the city’s 215 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings went from 5 to 7, and it took 1.3% of the city’s 318 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out Aberdeen for detached houses in August (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in July (a buyers’ best bet).

faq.q: Is there bus service through Aberdeen?
faq.a: BC Transit route 21 (Aldergrove / Abbotsford) runs on Fraser Highway at the north edge toward Bourquin Exchange; no route through the interior rural roads was verified on the BC Transit system map.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
